Shared settings (author, license, bibliography, CSL, HTML/PDF format) come from
`_quarto.yml` at the repository root.

Paths are relative to this folder:

- `data/`   input datasets, e.g. `read.csv("data/my_data.csv")`
- `models/` fitted models (git-ignored), e.g. `brm(..., file = "models/Fit1")`
- `plots/`  static images, e.g. `![Caption](plots/figure.png)`

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
```
